name: Blood Creature A
description: These blood creatures hunt in packs, dropping from above onto prey. They drool bright red saliva when food is near.

features.name: Drop Attack
features.description: This blood creature treats falls as 10 squares shorter when calculating fall damage. After falling and taking no damage, they gain an edge on attacks and damage until the end of the turn.

name: Blood Creature B
description: An orb of tendrils split by a toothy maw that parts to reveal glowing red eyes, this blood creature clings to surfaces and their enemies.

features.name: Tendril Snare
features.description: When this creature gets a tier 3 result on a tendril attack against a Medium or smaller target, the target is grabbed. While the target is grabbed this way, this creature's bite attack deals an additional 2 dam to them, and this creature can use a maneuver to deal 2 dam to the target.

name: Blood Creature C
description: A malleable creature that most often resides in somewhat humanoid form, this monster has the power to knock down doors to get at prey but prefers to flow through them.

features.name: Malleable
features.description: This blood creature can fit through spaces as small as 1 inch wide and never needs to squeeze. They can't be grabbed or knocked prone.

name: Ring Collector
description: The Ring Collector is a creature gifted with supernatural strength and speed who is obsessed with finding and collecting magic rings. They invaded and wiped out several villages during the Necromancer War in pursuit of rings. The Ring Collector is Craelin's advisor, Namlin. Namlin stayed loyal to the archmage after he became a necromancer even after all others left Craelin's side. As a gift, Craelin warped Namlin's flesh and turned them into a hunter of magic rings. Namlin became too covetous of their rings and refused to give them over to Craelin. The necromancer stripped the Ring Collector of their collection and imprisoned them in a crystal for insolence a short time before disappearing.

features.name: Ring Sense

description: These undead move in packs, like feral dogs — feral dogs that grow bony spines and can shoot them at a distance before closing in.

features.name: Leap

name: Undead B
description: When an undead A devours enough flesh, their body evolves, growing more and longer spines on their rotting form. Many groups of undead A have one or two of these creatures among their ranks, though the most successful packs consist almost entirely of undead B.

features.name: Lacerate
features.description: When the undead hits with their claws against a creature and damages their Stamina or gives them a wound, the target gains a laceration until they regain Stamina. When the target takes a maneuver and an action on their turn, they take 1 P dam for each laceration they have.

features.name: Spiked Counter
features.description: When the undead counters, they deal 5 dam.

name: Undead C
description: The many limbs of this horse-sized undead make them an agile, quick predator that can squeeze the breath and break the ribs of a victim as they scale a wall and into the dark to avoid other threats.

features.name: Grabber
features.description: When the undead gets a tier 3 result with a Crush attack against a Medium or smaller creature, the creature is grabbed. There is no limit to the number of creatures they can grab.

features.name: Big Bite
features.description: While they have a target grabbed, the undead's bite deals an additional 2 dam.

features.name: Squeeze
features.description: As a maneuver, the undead deals 2 P dam to each creature they have grabbed.

name: Undead D
description: A pile of skulls atop a mound of gelatinous flesh, a literal fire caused by the tormented souls trapped inside the undead burns in the belly of this creature.

features.name: Fire Beam
features.description: As an action, the undead shoots fire in a 10 x 2 line within 1 square of them. Each creature in the area must make an Agility RR. 1: 10 dam, 2: 5 dam, 3: No effect

features.name: Absorb
features.description: As a maneuver, the undead can grab the corpse of a human who has died within the last 24 hours that is within 2 squares of them and incorporate it into their form. The corpse and any mundane equipment it carries are destroyed, and the undead regains 10 Stamina.

name: Undead E
description: This lumbering pile of flesh seems to be two smaller humans fused to the back of a giant. All three of the heads are equipped with razor sharp teeth and babble nonsense as they stalk prey with heavy, tireless steps.

features.name: Grabbing Fist
features.description: When the undead gets a tier 3 result with their fist against a Medium or smaller target, the target is grabbed. The undead can grab up to two targets at a time, and deals an additional 3 damage to targets they have grabbed with melee attacks.

features.name: Bite Frenzy
features.description: As an action, the undead makes a bite attack that targets each enemy within 1 square of them.

features.name: Horrid Gnashing
features.description: When a non-undead creature with a Mind score of 1 or lower starts their turn within 1 square of the undead, they take a bane on all tests until the start of their next turn.

name: Undead F
description: Formed from the muscle, sinew, and jagged bones of humans, this moving pile of gore can form weapons out of their bones and hurl toxic chunks of its own flesh at their enemies.

features.name: Exploding Mote
features.description: As an action, the undead hurls a chunk of their flesh that explodes into gas in a 4 cube within 10 squares of them. Each non-undead creature in the area must make a Strength RR. 1: 15 dam, 2: 7 dam, 3: No effect

features.name: Glorp Through
features.description: As a maneuver, the undead moves their speed without provoking opportunity attacks while entering other creatures' spaces at no speed penalty. Each creature's space they enter takes 1d6 dam. If they end this movement in another creature's space, the undead slides the creature into the nearest unoccupied space of their choice.

features.name: Liquid Death
features.description: When the undead is reduced to 0 Stamina, their body explodes in a fountain of acidic gore. Each creature within 2 squares of them takes 1d10 dam.

name: Undead G
description: The souls of powerful warriors and mages are fused into a single corpse and suit of armor to create this undead, who is a master of magic and swordplay. They take great delight in crushing their toughest opponent in front of an audience of weaklings.

features.name: Rust
features.description: When the undead deals damage to a creature wearing metal armor or wielding a sword or a shield with Rustswords, each item has its AD reduced by 5 after the attack.

features.name: Hurl Away
features.description: When the undead hits with Begone, they can vertically slide the target 3 squares on a tier 2 result, or 5 squares on a tier 3.

features.name: Extra Action
features.description: The undead can take one additional action or maneuver on their combat turn.

features.name: Insect Breath
features.description: As an action, the undead breathes a plague of stinging insects in a 5 cube within 1 square of them. Each enemy in the cube must make an Agility RR. 1: 20 dam, 2: 10 dam, 3: No effect

features.name: Rise!
features.description: A human killed by this undead rises as an undead creature A 1d6 rounds after death.

name: Undead H
description: A massive tower of bone, muscle, mouths, and thinly stretched skin, this undead hoards the remains of their kills, forming them into new undead once enough have been gathered. They can also grow swords made of human spines instantaneously from their hands.

features.name: Weakening Blade
features.description: When the undead damages a creature with their spineswords, the creature is weakened.

features.name: Vorpal Bite
features.description: When the undead scores a crit with their bite attack against a Large or smaller creature, the creature's head is removed.

features.name: Extra Action
features.description: The undead can take one additional action or maneuver on their combat turn.

features.name: Whirlwind
features.description: As an action, the undead moves up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks. Each enemy they come within 2 squares of at the start of, end of, and during the move takes 1d10 dam.

features.name: Damned Shriek
features.description: As a maneuver, the undead's many mouths open in a hideous, discordant scream. Each enemy within 5 squares of the undead must make a Mind RR. 1: Prone and vulnerable, 2: Prone, 3: No effect
